title: update_last_message_at silently succeeds on nonexistent chat_id
description: ChatStore::update_last_message_at calls UPDATE chats SET last_message_at = ?1 WHERE id = ?2 and checks affected > 0. If affected == 0 (chat does not exist), it commits an empty transaction and returns Ok(()). This is documented as 'Returns Ok(()) silently if chat_id is not found.' The caller in the message delivery path does not verify the chat exists before calling this. If a chat row is somehow absent (e.g. race with deletion, or a bug in the create path), last_message_at silently never gets set, the chat appears to have no messages in the UI, and no error is surfaced. The correct behavior for a missing chat_id is to return Err so the caller can detect and handle the inconsistency.
